summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund, a non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K to disclose a $0.1906 per share distribution payable September 29, 2026, and update its continuous private placement. The filing notes $8.5 million of subscriptions received in August 2026 and provides NAV and leverage data as of July 31, 2026. This is a routine disclosure of a regular distribution and fundraising update, not a special-situation event. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action is present. The registrant acts purely as a filer reporting ordinary operational activity.
